async function save(x) {}

// CASE js_multi_arrow_expr expect=pass
function a1(ids, handlers) {
  for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) handlers.push(async () => await save(ids[i]));
}

// CASE js_multi_fn_expr expect=pass
function a2(ids, handlers) {
  for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    handlers.push(async function () {
      await save(ids[i]);
    });
  }
}

// CASE js_multi_object_method expect=pass
function a3(ids, jobs) {
  for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    jobs.push({
      async run() {
        await save(ids[i]);
      },
    });
  }
}

// CASE js_single_object_method expect=pass
function a4(ids, jobs) {
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    jobs.push({
      async run() {
        await save(ids[i]);
      },
    });
  }
}

// CASE js_reverse_listener expect=pass
function a5(els) {
  for (let i = els.length; i--; ) {
    els[i].addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
      await save(e);
    });
  }
}
